description: Write a config file on this host from contents sent in the call. The caller sends a name and the contents (run input field content, so the script is declared input=fields in scripts.conf); this host's config-deploy.conf says which names exist, the absolute path, owner and mode each is written with, and the command that checks the new contents first. The caller cannot choose a path, owner or mode. Contents equal to the installed file change nothing (changed false). A write is staged beside the target, checked by the validate command if the map gives one, the old file is kept as <path>.prev, and the new one is renamed into place. Contents are limited to 1 MiB. Set test to true to do everything except the final rename and report would_change. Set list to true to list the names this host offers with the path, sha256, size, owner and mode of what is installed. Scripts are not a supported target.

list.description: List the names this host offers, each with path, whether the file exists, sha256, size, owner, mode and whether a validate command is set. Changes nothing; the name and input are not used.

test.description: Stage and validate the contents but do not install them; reports would_change. Needs the input field content.

name.description: The config name, as listed in the agent's config-deploy.conf (see list).

content.description: The full text of the file to install, at most 1 MiB. Not used when list is true.
